verdict.rationale: Bland's own Evals feature uses LLM judges to grade calls. You define eval agents, each grading one dimension of a call, and a judge decides whether the agent did what you wanted. That covers AI-driven quality scoring and pass/fail checks, and the MCP server can also run evals. missing for 10: evidence that evals run automatically on every call, explicit resolution analysis, explicit failure flagging or alerting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically

citations.quote: Evals let you measure the quality of your calls with LLM judges. You define eval agents, each of which grades one dimension of a call
An evaluation is a judge reading a conversation and saying whether the agent did the thing you wanted.
